reviews.title: Super helpful even at free level
reviews.text: This app does a great job at helping me do just like its name: stay focused on my to-dos! I’ve used other Pomodoro timer apps before to help with my ADHD brain but this is now my daily go to. It gives me extra focus to stay on track since I know it’s only for 25 minute sprints and I’ll get a quick break in between. I try to get up in the 5 minute breaks and move or go to the bathroom or send a text to a friend etc. This app also does a good job of keeping it very functional even at the free level which I use. I appreciate that, and I have found little premium features that would be nice to have, so some day I might even get it together and upgrade.

reviews.title: ADHD - Incredibly Helpful
reviews.text:
(I’m about to launch into a longish example of a typical day. Skip to the next to last paragraph if you’d like). 

I have a very hard time focusing on one task. I sit to balance the checkbook and I notice the cat’s food bowls are empty. As I go get cat food, I notice that the cat food bag is nearly empty. I get my phone to put cat food on my phone’s grocery list. Oh, my sister texted and is having a rough day. I start to message her back. If you have ADHD you can probably relate. (BTW- I forgot about the checkbook and the cats didn’t get fed.)

How Focus To-Do helps me. I want to balance my checkbook. I start my 25 minute focus timer. As I work, I think of the cat’s food bowl and several other tasks. I write those down and think, “I’ll do those on my breaks.” On the breaks, do those things. I feel a lot more relaxed and a more in control. Because of ADHD “time blindness,” I often underestimate the time needed to complete a task!

For me, Focus To-Do Timer is a Godsend.

reviews.title: Great App
reviews.text:
Thank you for creating such a powerful and fantastic focus app. I have been using it for several years now and have proudly purchased the lifetime license.

Based on my experience, I have 4 feature suggestions that I believe would significantly enhance the app's performance and user experience. Here are my thoughts:

1. Custom Date Range for Reports: Currently, users cannot select a custom period in the report section and are limited to the app's predefined periods. When I need to review a specific timeframe, I have to manually navigate through days and sum up the hours myself.

2. Project-Specific Reports: There is currently no option to filter reports by a specific project; it displays all active projects together. Having a dedicated filter for individual projects would be incredibly helpful.

3. Customizable Start Day of the Week: It is currently impossible for users to change the start day of the week to align with their local or personal schedule.

4. Hourly Rate & Billable Tracking: It would be amazing if we could mark projects as "billable" or "non-billable" and set a specific hourly or total rate (e.g., $6/hour or $2000 total rate of project). The app could then automatically calculate total earnings for that project within the selected report period.

You are already doing a fantastic job, and implementing these features would take this app to the next level!

Best regards, Reza

reviews.text: Overall, it gets the job done. I love how it can be used across my desktop computer and my iphone. but one huge problem makes me want to find an alternative. The widgets on iPhone are horrendous, especially considering it’s a paid app. One of the widgets is mislabeled, saying it shows time remaining even though it’s actually displaying time used. The biggest offense of all, it doesn’t update. Even if you open it and resting the app, the widget doesn’t update. It’s infuriating to try to take a quick glance at my home screen to see how much time I still have left to work, and it’s off by 3 or 4 hours. Please just give your widgets a quick pass. I love the app, I use it all the time, but the inaccurate and mislabeled widgets make it do more harm than sometimes.

reviews.title: Amazing App for ADHD brain
reviews.text:
I have to say after trying many things this app is working for me as a ADHD person who struggled throughout your life. It does induce sense of urgency for work which leads to completion. I like the tasks feature as well as it keeps you organized as well.

Opportunities for improvement: For this to work as an all inclusive tasks and routines app: would recommend adding task repetition/times a week eg 3 times a week rather than rigidly picking up days of the week.
Second please add the option of new task appearing after the first one is completed. Eg currently it’s a rigid structure eg every Monday of the week etc, make it selectable as 1 week after completion as well.
Thanks
